comparison.objective: Build a level mixed-carton pallet layer; candidate tunes and locks a damper for controlled carriage stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Pairing, standing and bridging cartons by height versus socket manipulation, fine collar rotation and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Top cartons level on equal-height supports versus two consecutive safe stops without bottoming, overload, rebound or drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual manipulation, but the tested abilities and physical outcomes are materially different.
